status: Prospective fixed-method measurement plan, not external preregistration
conditions: Reference, pitch-only, duration-only, independent pitch+duration, each with input or post-residual SNR target; one pure-background input control
physical_channel: Fixed varied room/microphone per run, continuously filtered source/background components, slowly modulated background and halfway fan/level change
source_transform: librosa 0.11 pitch_shift (n_steps=12log2 ratio) and time_stretch (rate=1/duration factor), n_fft1024 hop256; independent RNGs; ratio log-uniform0.85-1.15 and duration uniform0.8-1.2 capped at0.94 seconds
target_definition: Active pre-channel interval. Input uses source/background before channel; post_residual uses current-source response/residual after channel, including all prior source tails in residual. Background-only post SNR is also reported. Same ratio interval, not whole-IR-tail energy.
probes: Before each real foreground observation, copy learner state, observe current-source-removed waveform with all earlier physical tails retained, discard branch. Real trajectory always receives original mixture. No event truth or component arrays are passed to observe().
metrics: Pre/post SNR per class, component recombination, independent transform factors, localized repeat identity, attention/overlap/identity without new source and paired seed intervals
limits: Procedural classes remain evaluator proxies; phase-vocoder artifacts differ from natural source variation. Source removal is a local intervention in this linear simulator, not field or semantic importance evidence. No method tuning on evaluation.
